name: Lunar Patience
description: A noncritical Moonbeam prepares +1 for the next Moonbeam main offensive roll in the same battle. The bonus does not stack and clears on a critical hit.
levelUpLine: lvl 39 Passive 🌙 Lunar Patience: When Moonbeam fails to critically hit, your next Moonbeam in the same battle gains +1 to its main offensive roll. Lunar Patience does not stack and resets when Moonbeam critically hits or the battle ends.
